LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 2.1.1 PRONUNCIATION AND VOCABULARY

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Sharing duties and responsibilities Suggested vocabulary share, duty, responsibi
Topic 2.1: Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and vocabulary
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and vocabulary, part of Sharing duties and responsibilities Suggested vocabulary share, duty, responsibi in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why should we pronounce words correctly?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1.  listen to the teacher model or an audio recording the target letter- sound combinations (‘dr’, ‘fl’, ‘fr’ and ‘gl’)

2. Pronounce the target letter- sound combinations by taking turns.

3. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication.  Listen to and say tongue twisters with the target letter- sound combination.  Sing/hum/mime simple songs or recite poems with target letter- sound combinations.  Construct simple sentences

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1.  listen to the teacher model or an audio recording the target letter- sound combinations (‘dr’, ‘fl’, ‘fr’ and ‘gl’)
2. Pronounce the target letter- sound combinations by taking turns.
3. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication.  Listen to and say tongue twisters with the target letter- sound combination.  Sing/hum/mime simple songs or recite poems with target letter- sound combinations.  Construct simple sentences

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and vocabulary together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
 Communication: The learner’s ability to listen keenly and clearly is enhanced as they listen and respond appropriately to

three directional instructions.

 Collaboration: The learner’s ability to contribute to group activity is enhanced as they participate actively in role play with

peers and observe the rules of engagement.

12

Values:
Responsibility is enhanced as the learner engages in assigned roles and duties at home and at school.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills (Self-awareness): The learner’s self-awareness is improved as they learn about the duties at home and at school.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner will apply attentive listening skills in learning of other concepts in all learning areas.
